subject: general
question:
The given pie diagram shows how a student spent his pocket money amounting to Rs.3,500 during the course of a month.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d1f26415a3e3c82068c5bcc5b1051ed08745fbf3be8fb8e76e587caa9f4a55e.png] 

How much more money (in Rs.) did he spend on food as compared with what he spent on entertainment?
solution:
**Given:**

Total pocket money = Rs 3,500

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d1f26415a3e3c82068c5bcc5b1051ed08745fbf3be8fb8e76e587caa9f4a55e.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount spend on entertainment = 20% of 3500

⇒ Amount spend on entertainment = (20)/(100)times 3500=Rs 700 

⇒ Amount spend on food = 50% of 3500

⇒ Amount spend on food = (50)/(100)times 3500=Rs 1750 

⇒ More amount spent on food than entertainment = 1750 – 700 = Rs 1050

**Therefore, Rs 1,050 is spend more on food as compared to entertainment.**
